lines.text: At twenty, he walked away from college for a forty million dollar contract.
lines.caption: At 20, he walked away from college for a $40 million contract.

lines.text: Four years later, the Lakers paid him one hundred and twenty million more.
lines.caption: Four years later, the Lakers paid him $120 million more.

lines.text: But his mother had one request.
You promised me you would finish school.
lines.visual: quote|You promised me you'd finish school.|MOM
lines.caption: "You promised me you'd finish school."

lines.text: So in the middle of his NBA career, Shaquille O'Neal went back to college.
In two thousand, he earned his bachelor's degree from LSU.
lines.caption: In 2000, he earned his bachelor's degree from LSU.

lines.text: Then he noticed something in business meetings.
People shook his hand, and then talked to his agent.
So he earned an M B A. Now they had to talk to him.
lines.caption: So he earned an MBA. Now they had to talk to him.

lines.text: Then his mom pointed out there were no doctors in the family.
In twenty twelve, he earned a doctorate in education.
lines.caption: In 2012, he earned a doctorate in education.

lines.text: One of the most famous athletes on earth became Doctor O'Neal.
lines.caption: One of the most famous athletes on earth became Dr. O'Neal.

lines.text: The money made him rich. The promise made him proud.
